about_lead: Joker Store is an online store specialized in digital cards, games and subscriptions at competitive prices with fast, secure service.
about_body: We aim to deliver a smooth shopping experience, with quick support and a guarantee that your code is delivered right after payment is confirmed.
about_value1_desc: All codes are genuine and sourced from trusted suppliers.
about_value2_desc: Receive your code within minutes of payment confirmation.
about_value3_desc: Our team is available to help you anytime.
faq_contact_hint: Didn't find your answer? Contact us via WhatsApp or the contact form.
faq_q1: How do I receive the code after paying?
faq_a1: The code is sent to the email address you provided, right after an admin confirms your transfer.
faq_q2: What if the code doesn't work?
faq_a2: Contact us within 24 hours and we'll replace the code or fully refund you under the Joker Store guarantee.
faq_q3: What if I didn't receive the code?
faq_a3: Use the order tracking page with your email, or message us directly and we'll handle it right away.
faq_q4: Do the codes work in all regions?
faq_a4: Yes, we offer cards for several regions (Turkish, US, European, Gulf and more), and the region is specified on each product.
faq_a5: We accept Jawwal Pay and PalPay; the transfer details appear on the checkout page.
privacy_lead: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
privacy_s1_desc: We only collect the email used to receive codes and basic order data, and we never share it with third parties.
privacy_s2_title: How do we use your data?
privacy_s2_desc: Your data is used exclusively to fulfil your orders, deliver codes and answer your inquiries.
privacy_s3_desc: We take technical and security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access.
terms_lead: By using Joker Store you agree to the following terms.
terms_s1_desc: Codes are genuine and guaranteed; use them in line with the platform's official provider terms.
terms_s2_desc: No cash refunds after the code is delivered, unless the code doesn't work and this is verified.
terms_s3_desc: We are not liable for misuse of a code or for it being shared with another party after purchase.
